note: Pricise intent registry for Scout (spec docs/intent-registry.md). One shopper, so roles are "*". Action intents (untick, checkout, notification) carry approval.require; scout/packs/pricise.json adds their policies (checkout.pay is always denied).

intents.description: Safe fallback when no registered intent clears the Reject band. Answers conversationally, never routes to tools or actions.
Check the product page the shopper is looking at: is the store safe, is the deal honest, and what is the best safe price.
examples: Check this product before I buy it

intents.description: Explain a deal finding from the stored check: discount claims, was-prices, countdown timers, fees and the real total.
examples: Why is the total higher than the listed price?
What fees will I pay at checkout?

intents.description: Explain whether the store or seller looks safe, from the trust findings of the stored check.
Find the best safe price for the exact same item at trusted stores.
examples: Find the best safe price for this
Is there a cheaper trusted store?

intents.description: Watch an item with a price rule. The rule is the shopper's approval for later price alerts on this item.
examples: Watch this item and tell me when it drops under $200
Alert me if the price falls

intents.description: Show a desktop notification for a watched item. Needs the shopper's watch rule for that item.
examples: Send me a desktop notification when the price drops

intents.description: Untick a pre-ticked add-on on the page. The only page change Pricise makes; needs the shopper's confirmation.
examples: Take the warranty off my cart

intents.description: Move the hidden browser to the next checkout step on a Store Lab page to find late fees. Stops before payment.
examples: Go to the next checkout step
Continue through checkout to see the fees
Walk the checkout to find the real total

intents.description: Pay, place an order or submit a checkout. Always denied: Pricise never buys.
